A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] worked as a '''librarian''' in the city of [[New Otoh Gunga]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier]]'', the librarian was voiced by [[Greg Burson]], who also voiced [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] in the same game.
